steps: Turn off power to the existing doorbell transformer if hardwiring.
Remove the old doorbell and check wiring voltage compatibility.
Mount the new bracket at the recommended angle for your entryway.
Connect the wiring or install the battery pack.
Complete app setup, adjust motion zones, and test the live view/chime.
